decisions.reason: The firm raised its visible commitment by giving the soap its own page in 2024, which signals continued investment and fits its wood floor care range.
The maintenance oil is a natural complement to the firm's wood floors and the care line it has publicly built, so low-cost persistence is likely despite only modest website prominence.
Promotion to a dedicated page shows growing public commitment to this care product for oiled floors, making a drop unlikely.
The moisture-protection underlay is an inexpensive accessory sold with floor installations and needs little investment to keep, though its unchanged, low visibility leaves some risk of quiet removal.
The high-density foam underlay is a traded add-on with low holding cost and supports floor sales, so management is likely to persist with it despite its unchanged, low visibility.
Oak parquet is central to the firm's core wood flooring direction, and management would likely attribute any weak results to the temporary construction downturn rather than drop it.
